journey.name: funding source dropdown
journey.description: Verifies that the Send Amount wallet picker opens as a dropdown: an outlined button with the selected wallet name followed by a downward chevron. Preconditions: an onboarded regtest wallet with confirmed Savings funds and a usable Spending channel, a fresh zero-amount unified BIP21 URI (on-chain address plus Lightning invoice) from another wallet, and a fresh on-chain address from another wallet. Close each send without paying.

actions.action: Open the zero-amount unified BIP21 URI with a bitcoin: deep link

Verify Send Amount shows the funding source button (testTag "AssetButton-switch") as an outlined button with the selected wallet name and a downward chevron after it, and no switch arrows before the name
Tap the funding source button and verify the dropdown (testTag "SendFundingSources") lists Savings and Spending with their balances and a check next to the selected wallet
Select the wallet that is not checked and verify the button shows its name in its color, orange for Savings and purple for Spending, still outlined with the downward chevron
Tap the funding source button again and verify the check moved to the newly selected wallet; dismiss the dropdown
Close the send sheet without paying
Open the on-chain address with a bitcoin: deep link and verify the funding source button shows Savings outlined in orange with no chevron or other icon

Tap the funding source button and verify the dropdown (testTag "SendFundingSources") opens with Savings checked and Spending dimmed with its balance; tap Spending and verify the selection does not change
Close the send sheet without paying
